guest_info.name: Paul Salter
guest_info.title: High Performance Hypnotherapist and Mindset Coach
guest_info.specialty: Helping real estate and financial services professionals get unstuck

main_topics: The dangers of constant availability in real estate
Balancing intensity and consistency for success
The importance of self-care and personal time management
The impact of neglecting personal relationships for work
Using intentional limitations to drive innovation and efficiency

problems_addressed.specific_problem: Feeling overwhelmed and disconnected due to constant work demands
problems_addressed.solution_summary: Return to the fundamentals that made you effective before success made you reactive.

problems_addressed.specific_problem: Neglecting personal time and self-care for work commitments
problems_addressed.solution_summary: Audit your calendar to prioritize self-care and family time before work commitments.

target_avatars.relevance: This episode addresses the challenges of maintaining personal well-being while managing a successful career.
target_avatars.key_takeaway: Prioritize personal time and self-care to sustain long-term success and avoid burnout.

clip_worthy_moments.quote: If the best of the best, the most gifted athletic hardworking individuals in the world are abiding by these principles and having immense success, why are you or me any different?

clip_worthy_moments.suggested_hook: Are you pushing yourself harder than an Olympic athlete?

episode_summary: In this episode, Paul Salter discusses the importance of balancing work intensity with personal well-being to sustain long-term success in real estate. He emphasizes returning to foundational practices and prioritizing self-care and family time to avoid burnout. Salter also highlights how intentional limitations can foster innovation and efficiency.
